import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();ms=json.loads(Path('history-matches.json').read_text())
for m in ms:
 print('FILE',m['path'])
 for path,v in m['hits']:
  print('EXACT MATCH',path)
  keys=path.strip('/').split('/');o=m['complete']
  for k in keys[:-1]:o=o[int(k)] if isinstance(o,list) else o[k]
  print(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False))
queries=['"group irregularity strength" "n" "Cichacz" conjecture','"independent transversals" "f(k)" "2103.09139"','"ordered tight" "2212.13719" conjecture']
s=json.dumps({'queries':queries,'purpose':'Screen exact finite group labeling, transversal and ordered path targets for source-owned and later proofs'},indent=2)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'search1-plan.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),'search1-plan.json'],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
